description: This file defines the FrameProcessorMetrics class responsible for collecting and reporting various performance and usage metrics related to frame processing, including TTFB, processing time, LLM token usage, and TTS character usage.

classes.name: FrameProcessorMetrics
classes.description: A class for collecting and reporting metrics related to frame processing, including timing, resource usage, and specific metrics for TTFB, LLM, and TTS operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the metrics collector, setting up internal state variables.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the metrics collector with a task manager.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the metrics collector.

methods.name: task_manager
methods.description: Property to get the associated task manager.

methods.name: ttfb
methods.description: Property to get the current time-to-first-byte (TTFB) value.

methods.name: _processor_name
methods.description: Retrieves the processor name from core metrics data.

methods.name: _model_name
methods.description: Retrieves the model name from core metrics data.

methods.name: set_core_metrics_data
methods.description: Sets the core metrics data object.

methods.name: set_processor_name
methods.description: Sets the processor name in core metrics data.

methods.name: stop_ttfb_metrics
methods.description: Stops TTFB measurement and returns a metrics frame.

methods.name: stop_processing_metrics
methods.description: Stops processing time measurement and returns a metrics frame.
